prompt: Out of all of the feature-length theatrical films that John Carpenter directed before 2015, which has the longest running time?
answer: **_Starman_ (1984)**, with a running time of **115 minutes (1 hour 55 minutes)**, is the longest feature-length theatrical film directed by John Carpenter before 2015.
